description: Construct six three-entity interpretations with exactly one Form. Each explicitly satisfies the retained premises, negates the omitted premise and refutes unbounded numerical multiplication. The non-self-predicative model retains essential characterization; the scoped model retains uniqueness, ontological independence, explanatory and exemplar participation. Directed likeness drops symmetry; non-resemblance participation drops the likeness bridge. These are compatibility tests, not complete historical theories or proofs of explanatory adequacy.
